summary: Extensions reduce the generated surface and make change, safety, and provenance observable.

items.text: Use a two-stage pipeline: the model proposes a domain-view schema, then a deterministic compiler selects components, actions, and layout from a versioned registry.
Regenerate only affected subtrees using stable semantic identifiers, and present a UI diff when navigation or action meaning changes.
Attach a provenance manifest containing source artifact hash, generator version, validation results, allowed actions, and rollback target to every generated UI bundle.
Let users pin layouts or opt out of adaptation; preserve personalization separately from regenerated domain content.
